verses.ar: أَبَانَ مَوْلِدُهُ عَنْ طِيبِ عُنْصُرِهِ ۞ يَا طِيبَ مُبْتَدَإٍ مِنْهُ وَمُخْتَتَمِ
verses.tr: Abāna mawliduhu ʿan ṭībi ʿunṣurihi · Yā ṭība mubtadaʾin minhu wa mukhtatami
verses.en: His birth made plain the purity of his origin — O how pure were his beginning and his end!

verses.ar: يَوْمٌ تَفَرَّسَ فِيهِ الْفُرْسُ أَنَّهُمُ ۞ قَدْ أُنْذِرُوا بِحُلُولِ الْبُؤْسِ وَالنِّقَمِ
verses.tr: Yawmun tafarrasa fīhil fursu annahumu · Qad undhirū biḥulūlil buʾsi wan niqami
verses.en: A day on which the Persians sensed that they had been warned of the coming of misery and retribution.

verses.ar: وَبَاتَ إِيوَانُ كِسْرَى وَهُوَ مُنْصَدِعٌ ۞ كَشَمْلِ أَصْحَابِ كِسْرَى غَيْرَ مُلْتَئِمِ
verses.tr: Wa bāta īwānu kisrā wa huwa munṣadiʿun · Ka shamli aṣ-ḥābi kisrā ghayra multaʾimi
verses.en: The palace of Chosroes passed the night split apart, like the fellowship of Chosroes' people, never to be made whole again.

verses.ar: وَالنَّارُ خَامِدَةُ الْأَنْفَاسِ مِنْ أَسَفٍ ۞ عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّهْرُ سَاهِي الْعَيْنِ مِنْ سَدَمِ
verses.tr: Wan nāru khāmidatul anfāsi min asafin · ʿAlayhi wan nahru sāhil ʿayni min sadami
verses.en: The sacred fire lay dead of breath from grief over it, and the river ran dry of eye from sorrow.

verses.ar: وَسَاءَ سَاوَةَ أَنْ غَاضَتْ بُحَيْرَتُهَا ۞ وَرُدَّ وَارِدُهَا بِالغَيْظِ حِينَ ظَمِي
verses.tr: Wa sāʾa sāwata an ghāḍat buḥayratuhā · Wa rudda wāriduhā bil ghayẓi ḥīna ẓamī
verses.en: It grieved Sāwa that its lake sank away, and the one who came to it thirsty was turned back in rage.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّ بِالنَّارِ مَا بِالمَاءِ مِنْ بَلَلٍ ۞ حُزْنًا وَبِالمَاءِ مَا بِالنَّارِ مِنْ ضَرَمِ
verses.tr: Ka anna bin nāri mā bil māʾi min balalin · Ḥuznan wa bil māʾi mā bin nāri min ḍarami
verses.en: As though, in grief, the fire held the wetness of water, and the water held the fire's own burning.

verses.ar: وَالجِنُّ تَهْتِفُ وَالأَنْوَارُ سَاطِعَةٌ ۞ وَالحَّقُ يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مَعْنىً وَمِنْ كَلِمِ
verses.tr: Wal jinnu tahtifu wal anwāru sāṭiʿatun · Wal ḥaqqu yaẓ-haru min maʿnan wa min kalimi
verses.en: The jinn cried out, the lights blazed forth, and the Truth appeared in meaning and in word.

verses.ar: عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا فَإِعْلاَنُ الْبَشَائِرِ لَمْ ۞ يُسْمَعْ وَبَارِقَةُ الْإِنْذَارِ لَمْ تُشَمِ
verses.tr: ʿAmmū wa ṣammū fa iʿlānul bashāʾiri lam · Yusmaʿ wa bāriqatul indhāri lam tushami
verses.en: They were blind and deaf: the proclamation of glad tidings went unheard, and the lightning of warning went unheeded.

verses.ar: مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَخْبَرَ الْأَقْوَامَ كَاهِنُهُمْ ۞ بِأَنَّ دِينَهُمُ الْمُعْوَجَّ لَمْ يَقُمِ
verses.tr: Min baʿdi mā akhbaral aqwāma kāhinuhum · Bi anna dīnahumul muʿwajja lam yaqumi
verses.en: This, after their soothsayers had told the peoples that their crooked religion would not stand.

verses.ar: وَبَعْدَمَا عَايَنُوا فِي الْأُفْقِ مِنْ شُهُبٍ ۞ مُنْقَضَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضَ مِنْ صَنَمِ
verses.tr: Wa baʿda mā ʿāyanū fīl ufqi min shuhubin · Munqaḍḍatin wifqa mā fīl arḍi min ṣanami
verses.en: And after they beheld on the horizon shooting stars falling, matching the idols toppling on the earth.

verses.ar: حَتَّى غَدَا عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْوَحْيِ مُنْهَزِمٌ ۞ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ يَقْفُوا إِثْرَ مُنْهَزِمِ
verses.tr: Ḥattā ghadā ʿan ṭarīqil waḥyī munhazimun · Minash shayāṭīni yaqfū ithra munhazimi
verses.en: Until, from the path of revelation, one routed devil fled following upon another routed one.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ هَرَبًا أَبْطَالُ أَبْرَهَةٍ ۞ أَوْ عَسْكَرٍ بِالحَصَى مِنْ رَاحَتَيْهِ رُمِي
verses.tr: Ka annahum haraban abṭālu abrahatin · Aw ʿaskarin bil ḥaṣā min rāḥatayhi rumī
verses.en: In their flight they were like the champions of Abraha, or an army pelted with pebbles from his blessed hands.

verses.ar: نَبْذًا بِهِ بَعْدَ تَسْبِيحٍ بِبَطْنِهِمَا ۞ نَبْذَ الْمُسَبِّحِ مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ مُلْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Nabdhan bihi baʿda tasbīḥin bi baṭnihimā · Nabdhal musabbiḥi min aḥshāʾi multaqimi
verses.en: Cast out by his hands after they had glorified Allah within his palms, as the glorifier was cast from the belly of the whale.
